description: Pack a list of cargo SKUs into one or more shipping containers using the Kubova solver. Supports bulk loading (cartons straight into the container) and pallet loading (loadingMode:"pallet" + a pallet — cartons are stacked onto pallets first, then the pallets loaded). Per-SKU you can set allowed orientations, no-overstack/no-understack, and loading order. Returns per-container placements with x,y,z coordinates in cm, listed in the order to load them (each piece after the pieces it rests on, rear-order cargo before door-order cargo, back wall to door), volume utilization, weight, a weightBalance object (centre of gravity + front/back & left/right weight split, flags an unbalanced load) for bulk loads, and any unplaced pieces.

loadingOrder.description: Placement priority: rear = deepest (unloaded last), door = closest to the door (unloaded first).

noOverstack.description: Nothing may rest on top of this SKU.

noUnderstack.description: Floor only — this SKU may not sit on other pieces.

orientations.description: Explicit allowed-pose subset; overrides allowRotation when set. standard = upright, turnup/turnside = tipped onto a face; 0/90 = yaw.

quantity.description: Number of identical pieces of this SKU.

weightKg.description: Weight of ONE piece in kg — NOT the row total. If a packing list shows both "weight/piece" and "weight total", use weight/piece (total = quantity × weightKg).

loadingMode.description: 'bulk' (default) loads cartons straight into the container. 'pallet' first stacks cartons onto pallets, then loads the pallets — requires the `pallet` field.

deepOptimize.description: Pallet mode only: run the exact optimizer for a tighter pallet plan (slower; Pro/Team plans).

pallet.description: The pallet to stack onto. Required when loadingMode is "pallet".

baseHeightCm.description: Pallet base self-height (cm), added below the cargo stack.

maxStackHeightCm.description: Max cargo stack height ON the pallet (cm), excluding the base.

tareWeightKg.description: Pallet self-weight (kg), added to container payload.

name: pack_containers
